observations.summary: Before wiring, make the pub(crate) slice form assess_private_descendant private/test-only; a caller could fabricate Entries(v.len()) after filter_map(entry) and turn omission into acceptance. Keep assess_private_descendant_capture as the only crate-visible entry.
Pin exact mode (0o4600, 0o2700, 0o1700, 0o500 refuse; P14/P15) and kind/type mismatch both ways (P16/P17).
Native test accepts every state, has a redundant branch, and has no Drop cleanup (P01/P03 failures left scratch dirs). Add a guard and real-ACE cases via /bin/chmod +a.

On this host fresh objects and chmod -N read as NotReturned; Entries(0) was not observed. Acceptance needs an explicit ACL (deny, invoking-user allow or zero-right allow). Creator must install an explicit ACL or obtain a reviewed per-vnode premise.
Row description ('no group or other access') understates the stricter predicate (other users, unresolved, inherit-only, unknown kinds/flags, single link, type/kind agreement).
assess_private_descendant_capture allocates an unaccounted Vec (<=128 x 16 B); judge entries in place to stay allocation-free.

Strict Clippy fails only on pre-existing work_ledger.rs new_without_default and trust/retained_metadata_index.rs needless_borrow (unchanged from HEAD); warn-level Clippy shows 0 diagnostics in the diff.
